subject: Great meeting at Fintech Summit — follow-up on inference needs
messages:
From: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.ai>
To: Samantha Chen <samantha.chen@paysea.com>
Date: 2027-04-10T15:22:00-07:00
Subject: Great meeting at Fintech Summit — follow-up on inference needs

Hi Samantha,

Really enjoyed our conversation at Fintech Summit yesterday about PaySea's payment reconciliation use-case. As discussed, teams are struggling with latency spikes during peak settlement windows and are interested in a deployment that balances cost + predictable latency.

Quick recap of next steps I proposed on the call:
- 30-min technical sync (recording ok) to walk your infra and peak QPS patterns
- Share short MRAP (model + runtime + API) doc tailored to your volume
- Identify a pilot scope (one service) and success metrics (p95 latency, cost per settlement)

Are you available for a 30-minute sync next week? I'm available Tue/Wed 10–12 PT. If easier, loop in your infra lead and I'll send a calendar invite.

Best,
Marissa Cole
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
Attachments: redwood-one-pager.pdf (attachment stub)
From: Samantha Chen <samantha.chen@paysea.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.ai>
Date: 2027-04-12T09:18:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Great meeting at Fintech Summit — follow-up on inference needs

Hi Marissa,

Thanks for following up — great to meet you too. This is a priority for Q3, but Q2 is packed. A 30-min tech sync sounds good to scope the pilot. Tue 4/13 at 11am PT works for me; I've copied our infra lead Ben (ben@paysea.com).

Best,
Samantha

Talk soon,
